method_config.candidate_source: WordNet first sense; base-form NN/JJ/RB/VB; lowercase single GPT2 token
method_config.description: Fixed seed codebook; two selectors; external payload length costs 32 bits; full serialized codebook counted separately; no semantic guarantee

train.text: organizing a volunteer bicycle repair workshop
storing vegetable seeds between growing seasons
designing accessible audio guides for a local museum
collecting rooftop rainwater for non-drinking uses

development.text: protecting old family photographs during archival storage
managing a public library book reservation queue

test.text: cooling handmade ceramic objects after firing in a kiln
balancing an underwater camera housing for shallow-water photography
preserving dark adaptation at a small astronomical observatory
coordinating safe backstage movement during a theatre performance

explanation.template: Write an informative English explanation of {topic}. Use approximately 180 words of ordinary natural prose. Do not use headings, lists, or quotations.

instructions.template: Describe in fluent English prose how someone can approach {topic}. Explain the practical sequence and reasons in about 180 words without numbering or bullet points.

narrative.template: Write a realistic English short story about a person involved in {topic}. Use around 180 words, ordinary vocabulary, and continuous prose without a title.

explanation.template: Prepare an English educational passage, roughly 180 words long, focused on {topic}. Present ideas in connected paragraphs with no title or enumerated list.

instructions.template: Offer an English practical account of the steps and precautions relevant to {topic}. Aim for 180 words and express the guidance as connected prose, with no headings.

narrative.template: Tell a plausible English narrative of approximately 180 words whose central activity is {topic}. Make it a continuous short story rather than a list or titled article.

explanation.template: Compose about 180 words in English that help a general reader understand {topic}. Use flowing explanatory paragraphs and leave out titles, quotations, and bullet points.

instructions.template: In about 280 English words, guide a newcomer through {topic}, including reasons for the main actions. Write naturally in paragraphs instead of a numbered procedure.

narrative.template: Create a believable scene and short English story centered on {topic}, using approximately 180 words. Keep the writing in plain continuous prose and omit a heading.

duplicate_policy.normalization: Unicode word tokens, casefold, whitespace join

pilot_limitations: Four test topic clusters cannot establish broad generalization.
External length framing requires accounting for 32 bits outside stegotext.
No superiority or security claim follows from a feasibility pilot.
Human semantic and grammatical evaluation is not part of this automated pilot.
